en: "Hi, Momotaro-san! I'm the big brother of the Riddle Oni Brothers!"{KP}"If you want to reach the exit up ahead, you have to cross the invisible bridge over there!"{KP}"To cross the invisible bridge, please listen to my hint!"{KP}"Ready? Listen carefully!"{KP}"Go north as many steps as an octopus has legs, then go east as many steps as a dog has legs!"{KP}"After that, go north again as many steps as a person has hands,"{KP}"then go west as many steps as a squid has legs!"{KP}"Last of all, go north as many steps as a beetle has legs!"{KP}"How's that? Easy, right!"
